turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm feeling a bit groggy, but okay. My tummy is sore, though.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understandable. Can you tell me your pain level out of 10?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Eh, maybe around 4 or 5? It's manageable, I think.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Are you feeling nauseous or have any vomiting since waking up?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No nausea, thank goodness. I hate throwing up.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. How's your breathing? Any discomfort or tightness in your chest?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is fine, no problem there.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Do you remember anything from the time you went into the operating room?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, everything's blank until now. I don't recall a thing.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's normal with general anesthesia. Given your diabetes and high blood pressure, are you having any dizziness or vision changes?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No dizziness, and vision seems okay. Just a bit tired, that's all.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. We'll keep monitoring your vitals and sugar levels. Let the nurse know if you need anything.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Will do, thank you. Hope to go home soon.
